painpoints.text: fabro-af22 (High, top claimable candidate) is a waiting-on-upstream seed: its close condition requires fabro-sh/fabro#784 merged AND in origin/denkhaus, but fix commit b635669a is not an ancestor of origin/denkhaus (verified this run). Nothing in the seed or tracker marks it blocked, so every lap re-adjudicates it. Suggestion: add an explicit 'blocked-on-upstream' status/label or move such seeds out of sd ready so planners skip them mechanically.

observations: fabro-af22 skipped as upstream-gated (#784 not in origin/denkhaus; lab workarounds must remain until the merge lands)

fabro-ead4 claimed: dup-run-check.nu already implements the seed's filed-only exclusion, so scope narrowed to the preflight closure arm + legend; this narrowing is recorded in the brief so the implementer doesn't re-derive it

Latent pre-existing crash found and fixed under the verified-adjacent-repair discipline: the old top-only close block in `.fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/planner-preflight.nu` assigned string fields to a mut record initialized with nulls, which nu 0.115 rejects with type_mismatch at runtime — the mechanical close likely crashed silently whenever it actually fired, a plausible contributing cause of the seed's motivating symptom (run 01M2SHNTQ returning closed seed:null).

Fixture batteries that resolve sibling scripts via `path self` break when copied elsewhere for debugging — the debug copy must live in the same `.fabro/scripts/` directory; cost one wasted battery run to learn.
nu `$"... ($id) ..."` interpolation consumes the parentheses as expression delimiters, so literal parens around interpolated ids vanish from fixture strings; string concat is the reliable form.
